name: Paradise Riflebird
rangeDescription: Eastern australia (dawes range, queensland to bellinger river, new south wales)
description: Large songbird with a very long decurved bill. Male almost completely black, with green and blue metallic sheen on belly, throat, and crown.

name: White-rumped Swallow
rangeDescription: Bolivia to paraguay, southeastern brazil, and northern argentina; winters to southern peru
description: A small swallow usually seen flying low over open and semiopen areas near water. Glossy blue-green above and white below.

name: Forest Buzzard
rangeDescription: South africa (western cape and eastern cape north to limpopo)
description: A resident, brownish buzzard of forest, forest edge, and adjacent open areas. The breast is heavily blotched with brown, and there is often a paler “U”-shaped patch on the lower breast.

name: Olive-green Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Lowlands of the guianas and adjacent northern brazil (amazonas)
description: Small, uncommon flycatcher of rainforest canopy. Plain, inconspicuous, and unobtrusive; occurs in tall forest, especially on sandy soils, and may also be found in shorter-stature forest on similar soil types.

name: Madagascar Rail
rangeDescription: Humid forest of eastern madagascar
description: A classic long-billed brown marsh rail. Found in grass and sedge wetlands in eastern Madagascar.

name: Mountain Avocetbill
rangeDescription: Central andes of colombia to northern peru (amazonas to la libertad)
description: Scarce Andean hummingbird with a short, awl-like bill that is upturned at the tip. Mostly green, and streaked with white on the underparts; also note the buff tinge to belly and white spot behind the eye.

name: Blue-winged Laughingthrush
rangeDescription: Montane forest of nepal to southwestern china, myanmar, and northwestern tonkin
description: Brown laughingthrush with a black brow and a bright silvery-azure panel on the wing. Wings, belly, and rump are more rufous-tinged than the rest of the body.

name: Sulawesi Brush Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Sulawesi region including banggai and sula islands (off eastern sulawesi) and buton and tukangbesi (to southeast)
description: A medium-sized cuckoo, with a warm buff colored throat, chest, and belly. Gray eyering and heavily barred tail.

name: Nubian Bustard
rangeDescription: Sahel from western mauritania to eastern sudan
description: Fairly large and lanky bustard. The face is boldly marked, with black throat and eyebrow patches and a rufous crown.

name: Indochinese Barbet
rangeDescription: Southern and eastern laos and vietnam
description: Loud but sluggish and difficult-to-see canopy inhabitant of the Annamite highlands in western Vietnam, eastern Laos, and far eastern Cambodia. Green with an electric-blue face, pale yellow crown and throat, and thick black eyebrows.

name: Masked Cardinal
rangeDescription: Northeastern colombia (southward to northern meta and eastern vichada), venezuela (except far southern) and trinidad
description: Unmistakable tricolored bird, with bold red, black, and white patches. Red hood and throat, black mask, mostly black back and tail, and white underparts.

name: White-throated Caracara
rangeDescription: Andes of southern argentina and southern chile to tierra del fuego
description: Uncommon in southern Andes; range does not overlap with Mountain Caracara. Favors open habitats above treeline, but also ranges lower to scavenge at dumps and in farmland with open trees.

name: Apurimac Spinetail
rangeDescription: Andes of southern peru (bosque de ampay region of apurímac)
description: Small, long-tailed bird found locally in humid montane forest in the Apurimac valley. Dark slaty gray with a rusty red cap and wings.

name: White-crested Turaco
rangeDescription: Far southeastern nigeria and northern cameroon eastward to western and southern south sudan, northeastern democratic republic of the congo, northern uganda, and western kenya
description: Beautiful turaco with a mostly white head, a black mark above the eye, dark blue wings and tail, and a green back and underparts. Like all turacos, shows large crimson wing patches in flight.

name: Blue-capped Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Forest of mindanao (southern philippines)
description: A spectacular medium-sized kingfisher of foothill and montane forest on Mindanao with a thick red bill, a white throat, a blue rump, and faintly scaled rufous on the underparts and cheek, extending around the back of the neck. The male has a blue crown, blue tail, and blue wings with buff spots.

name: Sichuan Thrush
rangeDescription: Breeds south-central china (central sichuan); winter range poorly known, but reported from northern vietnam (tonkin)
description: Little-known thrush which breeds in the dense hilly and montane forests of China’s northern and central Sichuan province; favors dense understory and coniferous stands. Brown above with scaled white underparts.

name: Tsingy Forest Rail
rangeDescription: Local in west-central madagascar (bemaraha and beanka massifs)
description: Chunky rail-like bird with rich rufous coloration. Found on the floor of dry forest in and adjacent to the limestone karst “tsingy” of Bemaraha and Beanka.

name: Blue-breasted Blue Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Northern philippines (mountains of northern and central luzon)
description: An attractive flycatcher of forest understory from the lowlands to low mountains in northern and central Luzon. Male has a deep blue throat, chest and upperparts, blackish face, and pale blue forehead and eyebrow.

name: Guadeloupe Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Varied forest types on guadeloupe (central lesser antilles)
description: A medium-sized, shy woodpecker that occupies most wooded habitats including mangrove swamps. This is a striking species, clothed nearly entirely in glossy black, save for the deep crimson belly and chest on many individuals.

name: Mindoro Cuckooshrike
rangeDescription: West-central philippines (mindoro, libagao, and tablas)
description: Sleek but sturdy gray bird with fierce pale eyes, endemic to the west-central Philippine islands of Mindoro, Libagao, and Tablas. Male is uniform overall, but darker on the tail, wingtips, and between the eye and bill.
